name: inherit inherited method
code: <?php class A{public function f(){return 7;}} class B extends A{} echo (new B())->f();

name: inherit inherited property
code: <?php class A{public $x=3;} class B extends A{} echo (new B())->x;

name: inherit override method
code: <?php class A{public function f(){return 3;}} class B extends A{public function f(){return 8;}} echo (new B())->f();

name: inherit instanceof
code: <?php class A{} class B extends A{} $b=new B(); echo (($b instanceof A)&&($b instanceof B))?"yes":"no";

name: inherit instanceof false
code: <?php class A{} class B{} $b=new B(); echo ($b instanceof A)?"yes":"no";

name: parent static method call
code: <?php class A{public static function f(){return 4;}} class B extends A{} echo B::f();

name: parent method instance dispatch
code: <?php class A{public function f(){return 3;}} class B extends A{public function f(){return parent::f()+5;}} echo (new B())->f();

name: parent constructor
code: <?php class A{public $x=0;public function __construct($x){$this->x=$x;}} class B extends A{public function __construct($x){parent::__construct($x+2);}} echo (new B(5))->x;

name: protected method child access
code: <?php class A{protected function f(){return 3;}} class B extends A{public function call(){return $this->f();}} echo (new B())->call();

name: private method internal access
code: <?php class A{private function f(){return 9;} public function call(){return $this->f();}} echo (new A())->call();

name: private property internal access
code: <?php class A{private $x=3;public function get(){return $this->x;}} echo (new A())->get();

name: protected property inherited child
code: <?php class A{protected $x=4;}class B extends A{public function get(){return $this->x;}} echo (new B())->get();

name: static property initial
code: <?php class A{public static $x=4;} echo A::$x;

name: static property update
code: <?php class A{public static $x=4;} A::$x+=3;echo A::$x;

name: static property inherited share
code: <?php class A{public static $x=1;}class B extends A{} B::$x=5; echo A::$x;

name: static method
code: <?php class A{public static function f($x){return $x+2;}}echo A::f(5);

name: static method named arguments
code: <?php class A{public static function f($a,$b=2){return $a+$b;}} echo A::f(b:4,a:1);

name: class constant
code: <?php class A{public const X=7;} echo A::X;

name: class const inherited
code: <?php class A{public const X=7;} class B extends A{} echo B::X;

name: class class name
code: <?php class A{} echo A::class;

name: private static access from method
code: <?php class A{private static $x=5;public static function get(){return self::$x;}} echo A::get();

name: class named constructor
code: <?php class A{public $x=0;public function __construct($a,$b=3){$this->x=$a+$b;}} echo (new A(b:4,a:2))->x;

name: method default argument
code: <?php class A{public function f($x=5){return $x*2;}} echo (new A())->f();

name: stdClass member assignment
code: <?php $o = new stdClass(); $o->a="v"; echo $o->a;

name: clone separates property
code: <?php class A{public $x=1;}$a=new A();$b=clone $a;$b->x=8;echo $a->x.":".$b->x;

name: clone keeps object nested identity
code: <?php class A{public $child;} $a=new A();$a->child=new stdClass();$a->child->x=1;$b=clone $a;$b->child->x=7;echo $a->child->x;

name: clone invokes hook
code: <?php class A{public $x=1;public function __clone(){$this->x+=2;}}$a=new A();$b=clone $a;echo $a->x.":".$b->x;
